records.name: im.livechat.expertise.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <list editable="bottom">
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <field name="user_ids" widget="many2many_tags" options="{'no_create': True}" domain="[['all_group_ids', 'in', %(im_livechat.im_livechat_group_user)d]]"/>
                </list>
            </field>

records.name: im.livechat.expertise.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form>
                    <sheet>
                        <group>
                            <field name="name"/>
                            <field name="user_ids" widget="many2many_tags" options="{'no_create': True}" domain="[['all_group_ids', 'in', %(im_livechat.im_livechat_group_user)d]]"/>
                        </group>
                    </sheet>
                </form>
            </field>
